item.title: What I'm working on:
item.description: Just moved from Prague 🇨🇿 to Amsterdam 🇳🇱 settling down in a new city, meeting new people, biking everywhere Upgrading systems continually improving my System for living better Writing notes to think better I write every day and share my notes to spark interesting conversations Exploring the intersection of design, learning, and games reading and writing about: How to use games to enhance learning? Teaching at Innovation Lab (CZ) co-creating an entrepreneurship seminar with Jan Vesely at the Charles University in Prague (remotely) making podcasts about entrepreneurship and games in education Searching for a job on the intersection of design, learning, and games I’d like to join a project where I could unleash my curiosity for designing game-based learning experiences
